title: Raw translation key guard
summary: Admin permission lists now show readable names, and a new check stops untranslated text from reaching any page.
changes: Show plugin permissions on Admin Roles and Permissions with their plain names, such as Assign tickets, instead of generated titles.
Add readable names for the Student and Volunteer area access permissions.
Add an automated check that renders pages for guests, public users, staff and Super Admins and fails if a translation key or snake_case text appears.
version_rationale: Patch: wording fixes plus a new test. Stored permission names, routes and data are unchanged.
validation: RenderedRawKeyGuardTest across 55 pages and four personas, with a self-check that it catches a raw key.
LocalisationAdminExtractionTest for the plugin permission label fallback.
Admin, localisation, permission, role and structure test files locally, and the full PHPUnit suite in CI.
known_limitations: The Change Log Hub is checked for translation keys only, because historic release notes quote code.
rollback: Redeploy the previous release package. No database change is involved.
